name: Landar
description: A Sharah woman sits alone in a shadowed booth, her scaled skin catching what little light reaches this corner. She nurses a drink with long, webbed fingers, her eyes distant as if watching something beyond the walls. Old salt crusts the edges of her cloak.
dialogue: *Landar glances up, her slitted pupils adjusting to your presence* You're not here for the quiet, are you? Sit if you want. I've got a story about the [unflooded sea] if you're curious.
*She taps a claw against her cup* Strange tides out there. Strange things buried in the silt.

keywords.unflooded sea: *Landar leans closer, lowering her voice* I saw someone out there last night. Near the old coral beds. They were burying something in a [mound] of silt. Looked heavy. Looked valuable.
keywords.mound: *She shrugs, scales rippling* A low rise of packed silt, just sitting there like someone wanted it found eventually. Or never found at all. Either way, someone with a [shovel] could [dig] it up. Not me though — I don't dig in other people's graves.
keywords.dig: *Landar waves a webbed hand dismissively* Digging's honest work, I suppose. Hard on the back though. You'd need a [shovel] and some strength to get through that packed silt.
keywords.shovel: *She gestures vaguely toward the common room* Jalia sells tools at her shop. Shovels, ropes, the things people need when they go poking around places they shouldn't. Tell her I sent you. Or don't. She doesn't care either way.
keywords.story: Stories cost drinks. But this one I'll give you free — something's buried in the [unflooded sea]. Something someone wanted hidden.
keywords.sharah: *Her eyes narrow slightly* My people came from deeper waters than this. The Unflooded Sea is shallow to us. But it has its secrets all the same.
